description: This file implements a finite state machine (FSM) for managing radio, access point, and endpoint states in a wireless management system. It includes functions for locking, dependency management, FSM transitions, and synchronization procedures.

methods.name: s_getMngr
methods.description: Retrieves the FSM manager associated with a radio object.

methods.name: s_doExternalLocking
methods.description: Checks if external locking functions are available in the FSM manager.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_doesExternalLocking
methods.description: Public function to determine if external locking is used for a given radio.

methods.name: s_printFsmBits
methods.description: Prints the FSM bits status for access points, endpoints, and the radio.

methods.name: s_copyPredepenencyBits
methods.description: Copies dependency bits from endpoints and access points to the radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_redoDependency
methods.description: Redoes dependency bits, only allowed in GLOBAL_SYNC stage.

methods.name: s_cleanFsmBits
methods.description: Cleans FSM bits for radio, access points, and endpoints.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_cleanFsmBits
methods.description: Public function to clean FSM bits.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_clearFsmBitForAll
methods.description: Clears a specific FSM bit for all access points and endpoints.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_cleanAcFsmBits
methods.description: Cleans all AC FSM bits for radio, access points, and endpoints.

methods.name: s_collectDependencies
methods.description: Collects all pending FSM bits from radio, access points, and endpoints.

methods.name: s_checkCommitPending
methods.description: Checks if a commit is pending and transitions FSM state accordingly.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_tryGetLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire the FSM lock for a radio.

methods.name: s_tryGetLock
methods.description: Attempts to get lock, using external functions if available.

methods.name: s_freeLock
methods.description: Releases the FSM lock, using external functions if available.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_freeLock
methods.description: Public function to free the FSM lock for a radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm_ensureLock
methods.description: Ensures the lock is held for a radio.

methods.name: s_ensureHasLock
methods.description: Ensures the lock is acquired before FSM operations.

methods.name: s_performSync
methods.description: Performs synchronization of radio, access points, and endpoints.

methods.name: s_syncVap
methods.description: Synchronizes VAPs (Access Points) dependencies.

methods.name: s_syncEp
methods.description: Synchronizes Endpoints dependencies.

methods.name: s_fsmRun_thf
methods.description: Timer callback to run FSM processing.

methods.name: s_checkAcFsmBitsHandling
methods.description: Checks consistency of AC FSM bits between endpoints, access points, and radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_fsm
methods.description: Main FSM state machine handling radio states and transitions.

methods.name: wld_fsm_reset
methods.description: Resets the FSM state of a radio.

methods.name: s_fsmState
methods.description: Returns the current FSM state of a radio.

methods.name: wld_fsm_init
methods.description: Initializes the FSM manager for a vendor.

methods.name: wld_fsm_getNrNotIdle
methods.description: Returns the number of radios not in IDLE state.
